questions.title: Which U.S. state will have the highest reported cyclospora case count by July 16, 2026?
questions.background: Cyclospora is a parasite that causes intestinal illness. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) monitors reported infections across U.S. states.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The latest CDC state-level data publicly available on July 16, 2026, reporting the cumulative number of cyclospora infections reported during 2026 Resolution Date : 2026-07-16 Accepted Answer Format : String (name of the U.S. state)
questions.current_reasoning: Major July 1 breaking outbreak update: Michigan Department of Health and Human Services (MDHHS) confirmed 174 cyclosporiasis cases reported across 17 southern/mid-Michigan counties between June 22 and June 30, 2026 (Monroe 70, Lenawee 33, Washtenaw 21, Wayne 12, Jackson 7, Shiawassee 7, plus 24 in 11 other counties and Detroit), with the source still unidentified and officials expecting additional cases. Meanwhile, July 1 coverage of CDC's latest published snapshot (as of June 16, onset May 1-June 6) shows only 145 domestically acquired cases nationwide across 17 states—led by New York (31-80), Texas (11-30), and Illinois (11-30), with Florida, Georgia, and Ohio at just 1-10 (Ohio has 11 cases since Jan. 1) and Michigan not yet included because its spike started June 22. Because Michigan alone already exceeds the entire prior U.S. domestic tally and June 22-30 cases have 16-24 days to enter CDC surveillance before July 16, Michigan vaults to 0.66 favorite. New York (0.16) retains #2 as current CDC leader and beneficiary of either a summer surge or CDC reporting lag, Texas drops to 0.11 (slow 11-30 start offset by historical late-June/July spikes), Illinois holds 0.03 (tied #2 in June 16 CDC data with Midwest proximity), and Florida drops sharply to 0.02 (only 1-10 through June 16), leaving 2% for other states (Ohio, Georgia, North Carolina, Wisconsin).

local_articles.title: What is cyclosporiasis? Michigan health officials share what to know amid outbreak
local_articles.snippet: Hundreds of Michiganders are getting sick amid a cyclosporiasis outbreak. Cases totaled more than 300 on Thursday afternoon, and the bulk of them are in Southeast Michigan. CBS News Detroit is getting answers from health experts about what this parasite is and how you can keep your loved ones healthy during the holiday weekend. The Michigan Department of Health and Human Services detected 228 cases of cyclosporiasis through Wednesday, and roughly 100 more through Thursday. They're expecting more to come because of how long it takes for symptoms to show. It's not deadly, but state health officials say people will start to have diarrhea, nausea, bloating and cramps one to two weeks after infection. questions.title: Which country will win the 2026 ICC Women's T20 World Cup?
questions.background: The Women's T20 World Cup is the International Cricket Council's world championship for women's national teams in Twenty20 cricket.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official tournament final result published by the International Cricket Council, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution : Resolve when the winner of the 2026 tournament is established by the final's official result. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the winning country.
questions.current_reasoning: July 1 Reuters/Straits Times confirmation that England captain Nat Sciver-Brunt has recovered from her calf strain and will lead England in Thursday's Oval semi-final against South Africa—stating she is 'able to take part in all aspects of the game'—removes the major injury cloud priced into yesterday's update. Having their premier all-rounder and captain back at full capacity lifts unbeaten host England's SF2 win probability vs South Africa from ~72.5% to ~77% and slightly improves England's home Lord's final outlook against 6-0 Australia (~41.5% vs ~39.3% previously). Combining with ~21.7% South Africa vs Australia yields England 0.32 (+0.035), Australia 0.63 (-0.025), and South Africa 0.05 (-0.01).

questions.title: Who will be named Player of the Tournament at the 2026 ICC Women's T20 World Cup?
questions.background: The Player of the Tournament award recognizes an individual player's performance across the competition.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The International Cricket Council's official announcement of the Player of the Tournament for the 2026 Women's T20 World Cup. Resolution Condition : Resolve when the recipient of the tournament-wide award is officially announced, rather than any individual match award. Accepted Answer Format : The recipient's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: June 30 Semi-Final 1 reshapes the Player of the Tournament hierarchy as Australia lock into Sunday's final and rise to 65.5% title favorites (West Indies/Hayley Matthews eliminated; England dip to 28.5%). Ashleigh Gardner surged from 0.08 to 0.16 after earning Semi-Final Player of the Match with 2/13 (two wickets in an over) and 35* off 20—backing up her 53* off 29 vs India and bolstering the reigning 2023 POTT's all-round knockout case. Beth Mooney enters the top five at 0.075 (replacing Sophie Ecclestone, ~0.052) after hammering 61* off 36 (her second fifty of the tournament, echoing her 2020 POTT blueprint), while Georgia Wareham ticks up to 0.07 after adding 2/17 (dismissing Matthews) to her group-stage POTM (32 & 3/13 vs SA) and elite economy. Ellyse Perry holds #1 at 0.30 (3 group POTMs, Australia's leading 185 runs, 4+ wickets): Australia's +11% title boost is offset by her retiring hurt on 2 with precautionary quad tightness (Molineux expects her fit for Sunday) and teammates closing the gap. Tournament leading run-scorer Danni Wyatt-Hodge (282 runs, two POTMs) trims slightly (0.20 -> 0.19) on England's lower title probability, leaving 20.5% outside the top five (Ecclestone, Charlie Dean, Marizanne Kapp, Sophie Molineux, Annabel Sutherland, Sciver-Brunt).

questions.title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One British Grand Prix?
questions.background: The British Grand Prix is held at Silverstone as part of the Formula One World Championship.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The race classification published by Formula One or the FIA, corroborated by contemporaneous race reporting. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the driver classified as the winner of the British Grand Prix scheduled for July 5, 2026. Sprint results do not count. Accepted Answer Format : The winning driver's name.
questions.current_reasoning: June 29-July 1 Silverstone technical and weather previews (Reuters/Straits Times, ESPN, GPFans/AutoRacer, F1Oversteer citing The Race/Telegraph) decisively favor Mercedes's dominant 2026 package (7/8 wins, 8/8 poles, 9 of last 13 British GPs). First, the weekend weather forecast is dry and warm (sunny/partly cloudy, mid-20s to 27C, little/no rain), removing the wet-weather equalizer Lewis Hamilton explicitly hoped for. Second, Silverstone's flat-out layout with few heavy braking zones makes it one of the harshest circuits of 2026 for electrical energy harvesting/deployment—where Ferrari lagged rivals by ~20 kph on straights in Austria despite a PU upgrade and Hamilton himself warned Silverstone does not look favorable on paper (partially offset by Ferrari bringing a low-drag diffuser and updated wing). Lifting Mercedes's combined share from 0.60 to 0.66 (Antonelli 0.33 -> 0.36; home challenger Russell 0.27 -> 0.30), moving Red Bull's upgraded Austria P2 finisher Max Verstappen ahead of Hamilton (0.10 -> 0.11, tempered by his simulator warning of tight Silverstone battery levels), trimming Hamilton (0.13 -> 0.09), and edging defending winner Lando Norris down (0.06 -> 0.05) after McLaren boss Andrea Stella conceded 'victory will be difficult', leaving 9% on Piastri (~0.04), Leclerc (~0.035), and the field.

local_articles.title: Norris and Hamilton expect Silverstone to be less challenging in new era
local_articles.snippet: SILVERSTONE, England, July 2 - Lando Norris expects Silverstone to be less of a challenge in his first home British Grand Prix as Formula One world champion, even if still providing plenty of excitement for fans. The McLaren driver won last year at the historic circuit but the sport's new engine era has changed the way drivers go racing, with energy management and recharging a crucial element now that power units have a greater electric component. "I think actually Sunday will be exciting. On the outside, I think it will be great," Norris said on Thursday. "Copse will certainly not be quite the same challenge it was over the last few years. Maggots, Becketts, maybe not quite the same challenge, but it’ll still be quick. I think it'll still be good to watch." local_articles.title: Drivers to lap Silverstone in Lego cars before British GP
local_articles.snippet: SILVERSTONE, England, July 2 - Formula One drivers will do a parade lap of Silverstone before Sunday's British Grand Prix in mini-cars made of Lego bricks. The stunt is one of a series in a tie-up between the Liberty Media-owned sporting organisation and the Danish toymaker, following on from events at several races in 2025. In Miami last year, the drivers took to the track around the Hard Rock Stadium in 10 life-size two-seater electric cars made of Lego. Last July, the top three finishers at the British Grand Prix were rewarded for their efforts with trophies made of Lego. And later, at Las Vegas, a Lego 1950s Cadillac made of more than 418,000 bricks and driven by actor Terry Crews was used to ferry the top three drivers to the podium. questions.title: Which UK party leader will announce plans in early July 2026 to resign as an MP and contest the resulting by-election?
questions.background: A parliamentary resignation can trigger a by-election, which the departing MP may contest to seek a fresh mandate.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public announcements corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from BBC News, The Guardian, or Al Jazeera. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the UK political party leader who publicly announces, between July 1 and July 9, 2026, plans to resign from the House of Commons and stand in the by-election caused by that resignation. The announcement is sufficient; the by-election need not have taken place. Accepted Answer Format : The party leader's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Rupert Lowe (Restore Britain leader, MP for Great Yarmouth) uniquely fits both historical UK precedents for an MP resigning to contest a by-election: he was elected under Reform UK in 2024 before launching Restore Britain in Feb 2026 (which just finished 3rd in Makerfield with ~7%), and on May 15, 2026 he lost his High Court challenge to halt a parliamentary ICGS watchdog probe, creating strong incentive to seek a fresh mandate or preempt a suspension/recall petition. Very few UK party leaders sit in the Commons; Nigel Farage (Reform UK), Jeremy Corbyn (Your Party, elected Independent), Zarah Sultana (ex-Labour/Your Party), and Kemi Badenoch represent smaller tails, with ~12% left for other minor-party MP leaders (e.g., Northern Ireland party leaders or a newly formed breakaway party).

questions.title: Who will Moldova’s parliament elect as prime minister to succeed Alexandru Munteanu?
questions.background: Alexandru Munteanu has resigned as Moldova’s prime minister, triggering his cabinet’s resignation. Moldova is pursuing European Union membership.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Moldovan parliamentary announcements or reliable news reporting confirming the election of a new prime minister. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the first person elected prime minister by Moldova’s parliament following Alexandru Munteanu’s resignation. A nomination or temporary appointment as acting prime minister does not qualify. Resolution Date : The date parliament elects the successor. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the person elected.
questions.current_reasoning: Moldova's pro-EU ruling party PAS holds a 55/101 parliamentary majority alongside President Maia Sandu, so the successor to PM Alexandru Munteanu (whose Control Corps resigned over loss of trust on June 24, 2026) will be a PAS-backed pick. Top internal cabinet/party contenders are Deputy PM & Foreign Minister Mihai Popșoi, Deputy PM for European Integration Cristina Gherasimov (aligned with the EU accession priority), PAS leader and Speaker Igor Grosu, Deputy PM Vladimir Bolea, and Deputy PM for Economic Development Eugen Osmochescu. Because Sandu and PAS have a strong base rate of tapping surprise technocrats or presidential advisers (as with Dorin Recean in 2023 and Munteanu in Nov 2025), 42% probability mass is left outside the top five.

questions.title: What principal criminal penalty will Hannah Dugan receive at her initial sentencing for obstructing a federal proceeding?
questions.background: A federal jury convicted Wisconsin judge Hannah Dugan of obstructing a federal proceeding in December 2025. The case concerned her response to immigration agents seeking to arrest a defendant at her courthouse.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The federal court’s sentencing judgment or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the sentence announced in court. Resolution Conditions : Resolve when the federal district court first imposes a sentence for Dugan’s obstruction conviction. Identify the principal criminal penalty imposed at that sentencing. Subsequent appeals or resentencing do not change the answer. Accepted Answer Format : A short noun phrase naming the principal criminal penalty.
questions.current_reasoning: Former Milwaukee County Judge Hannah Dugan (67, no criminal record, resigned Jan. 3) is scheduled for sentencing on July 8, 2026 before U.S. District Judge Lynn Adelman after he denied her post-trial motion on June 16. AP and Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reporting consistently emphasize that federal guidelines generally call for probation for nonviolent first-time offenders and that Judge Adelman is nationally known for below-guidelines, non-custodial sentences. A prison sentence remains a meaningful secondary risk (~18%) given DOJ pressure, abuse-of-judicial-trust aggravators, and expected lack of contrition ahead of her Seventh Circuit appeal, alongside smaller chances for home confinement, a standalone fine, or time served.
